text.autoconfig.dynamicnutrition.title: Dynamic Nutrition
Nutrient strip on the HUD
Show a compact five colour strip above the hunger bar.
HUD strip, horizontal offset
Move the strip sideways, in pixels, if another mod is already using that space.
HUD strip, vertical offset
Move the strip up or down, in pixels. Negative is up.
Inventory button
Show a small button in the inventory that opens the nutrition screen. The keybind works either way.
Inventory button, horizontal offset
Move the button sideways, in pixels, if it collides with another mod's.
Inventory button, vertical offset
Move the button up or down, in pixels. Negative is up.
Nutrients on food tooltips
Add a line to every food tooltip showing what it is worth. Hold F3 and H for where the values came from.
Nutrient effects

Give each nutrient its own effect: one above its green line, one below its red line. Carbs give Speed or Slowness, protein Strength or Weakness, fat Resistance or Hunger, vitamins Regeneration or Blindness, minerals Haste or Mining Fatigue. Every buff shows as Well Nourished and every debuff as Malnourished; hover either in the inventory to see which. The bars still move either way.
Announce status changes
Say on the action bar when your overall status changes, and which nutrient caused it.
Variety matters
Eating the same food over and over is worth less nutrition. Hunger is never affected.
Meals remembered
How many recent meals count towards repetition. Higher is stricter.
Repeat penalty
How much of a meal each repeat costs, as a percentage.
Least a meal can be worth
A repeated food never drops below this percentage, so one food source is never a dead end.
Show on the HUD
Show Well Nourished and Malnourished among the effect icons at the top right of the screen. Only affects you; the effects still work while hidden.
Show in the inventory
Show Well Nourished and Malnourished in the list beside the inventory, where hovering one lists the effects it stands for. Only affects you; the effects still work while hidden.
Speed strength
How strong Speed is while carbs are above their green line, as a percentage of vanilla Speed I. 100 is the full effect, 50 is half, 0 turns it off.
Slowness strength
How strong Slowness is while carbs are below their red line, as a percentage of vanilla Slowness I. 100 is the full effect, 50 is half, 0 turns it off.
Strength strength
How strong Strength is while protein is above its green line, as a percentage of vanilla Strength I. 100 is the full effect, 50 is half, 0 turns it off.
Weakness strength
How strong Weakness is while protein is below its red line, as a percentage of vanilla Weakness I. 100 is the full effect, 50 is half, 0 turns it off.
Resistance strength
How strong Resistance is while fat is above its green line, as a percentage of vanilla Resistance I. 100 is the full effect, 50 is half, 0 turns it off.
Hunger strength
How strong Hunger is while fat is below its red line, as a percentage of vanilla Hunger I. 100 is the full effect, 50 is half, 0 turns it off.
Regeneration strength
How strong Regeneration is while vitamins are above their green line, as a percentage of vanilla Regeneration I. 100 is the full effect, 50 is half, 0 turns it off.
Blindness strength
How strong Blindness is while vitamins are below their red line, as a percentage of vanilla Blindness I. 100 is the full effect, 50 is half, 0 turns it off.
Haste strength
How strong Haste is while minerals are above their green line, as a percentage of vanilla Haste I. 100 is the full effect, 50 is half, 0 turns it off.
Mining Fatigue strength
How strong Mining Fatigue is while minerals are below their red line, as a percentage of vanilla Mining Fatigue I. 100 is the full effect, 50 is half, 0 turns it off.
